 PM Modi Launches ₹15,600-Crore Development Projects in Bengaluru 
 Star marking (1-5) indicates the importance of topic -->
 Why in News?   
 Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated, dedicated to the nation, laid the foundation stone and flagged off various development projects worth over ₹15,600 crore in Bengaluru, Karnataka , covering metro, railway, energy security and infrastructure.   
 Key Points   
 Bengaluru Metro: The new Pink Line was dedicated to the nation, improving connectivity to IIM Bengaluru, educational institutions and major business and technology hubs.   
 Metro Network: Bengaluru's Namma Metro network has expanded from 17 km in 2014 to over 100 km , making it the third Indian city after Delhi-NCR and the Mumbai Metropolitan Region to achieve this milestone.   
 Railway Development: Four railway stations were brought under the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme , along with two doubling and electrification projects.   
 Vande Bharat Train: A new Vande Bharat train connecting Karnataka and Goa was flagged off, providing semi-high-speed connectivity along the coastal route, including Mangaluru.   
 Mangaluru LPG Project: The project will add 80,000 metric tonnes of LPG storage capacity, strengthening energy security.   
 Bengaluru CBG Plant: The Compressed Biogas (CBG) plant will produce 13 tonnes of biogas daily , supporting waste management and reducing dependence on imported natural gas.   
 PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana: Over 60 lakh households across India, including more than 40,000 families in Karnataka , have installed rooftop solar plants with central assistance of around ₹80,000 per family .   
 PM-KUSUM Yojana: More than 8 lakh solar pumps are being used to support irrigation for Karnataka's farmers, reduce electricity costs and generate additional income.   
 Renewable Energy: India's renewable energy capacity has crossed 300 GW .

 Commonwealth Women Parliamentarians Conference in Bengaluru 
 Star marking (1-5) indicates the importance of topic -->
 Why in News?   
 Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla will inaugurate the Conference of Commonwealth Women Parliamentarians (CWP) India Region in Bengaluru, Karnataka , in November 2026 .   
 Key Points   
 Inauguration: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla will inaugurate the conference on 17 November 2026.   
 Theme: ‘Strong Foundations, Stronger Voices: Inclusive Cyberspace and Mentorship Pathways for New Women Legislators’ .   
 Participants: Women legislators from Parliament and State/UT Legislatures, along with other distinguished dignitaries, will participate.   
 First Plenary Session: ‘Empowering Women Digitally: Safe Cyberspace, Smart Choices’ will be held on 17 November 2026.   
 Second Session: ‘Capacity Building and Mentorship for Women Legislators’ will be held on 18 November 2026.   
 UN Women India: It will organise a special side event on menopause .   
 Valedictory Session: The conference will conclude with the valedictory address by Karnataka Governor Dr. Sudha Yadav .

 Logo and Mascot Unveiled for 8th Edition of Khelo India Youth Games 2026 
 Star marking (1-5) indicates the importance of topic -->
 Why in News?   
 Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya and Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy unveiled the official logo and mascot for the 8th edition of the Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG) 2026 .    
 Key Points:   
 Khelo India Youth Games 2026: It will be the 8th edition of the Khelo India Youth Games.   
 Host State: Telangana.   
 Host Cities: Hyderabad, Khammam, Karimnagar, Hanumakonda, Mahabubnagar and Nizamabad.   
 Logo of Khelo India Youth Games 2026: The logo represents the cultural heritage of Telangana and its sporting aspirations through eight key elements.   
 Khelo India Emblem: Represents the national sports programme, youth and momentum through a saffron-and-green running figure.   
 Gandhi Tower: Part of the proposed Gandhi Sarovar at Bapu Ghat; symbolises peace, unity and Hyderabad's vision for the future.   
 Kakatiya Kala Thoranam: Represents Telangana's historical heritage and spirit of welcome.   
 Buddha Statue at Hussain Sagar: Symbolises harmony, discipline and tranquillity.   
 Tangedu Flower: Represents Telangana's cultural identity and the spirit of the Bathukamma festival.   
 Seven Sporting Silhouettes: Represent sporting diversity and aspirations.   
 Blue, Green and Yellow Ribbon: Symbolises movement, energy and inclusion.   
 Tagline: "Khel Ka Junoon, Telangana Ki Jaan Aur Pehchaan" .   
 Mascot – Neelamani:   
 The official mascot of the 8th Khelo India Youth Games 2026 is named Neelamani .   
 It represents energy, agility, determination and sportsmanship .   
 Neelamani embodies four defining qualities: Vibrant, Courageous, Agile and Pride .   
 Sports Disciplines: The 2026 edition will feature 29 disciplines , comprising:   
 27 Competitive Sports: Archery, Athletics, Badminton, Basketball, Boxing, Cycling, Fencing, Football, Gatka, Gymnastics, Hockey, Judo, Kabaddi, Kalaripayattu, Kho-Kho, Mallakhamb, Rowing, Shooting, Swimming, Softball, Table Tennis, Tennis, Thang-Ta, Volleyball, Weightlifting, Wrestling and Yogasana.   
 2 Demonstration Sports: Sailing and Karra Samu.   
 New Sports Introduced:   
 Softball: Will make its debut as a competitive discipline in the Khelo India Youth Games.   
 Sailing: Will be introduced as a demonstration sport for the first time.   
 Karra Samu: Will also make its debut as a demonstration sport.   
 Khelo India Initiative: It is a flagship sports development initiative of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports .   
 It aims to promote grassroots sports, identify sporting talent and strengthen India's sporting ecosystem.   
 Other events organised under the Khelo India initiative include:   
 Khelo India Youth Games.   
 Khelo India Beach Games.   
 Khelo India Winter Games.   
 Khelo India Tribal Games.   
 Significance: The Games aim to encourage greater participation of young people in sports.   
 They promote sportsmanship, physical fitness and a sporting culture.   
 The event also seeks to support the vision of Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat by encouraging youth to engage in sports and healthy activities.

 Indian Men's U-19 Cricket Team Wins Men's U-19 Asia Cup 2026 
 Star marking (1-5) indicates the importance of topic -->
 Why in News?   
 Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated the Indian Men's Under-19 Cricket Team for winning the Men's U-19 Asia Cup 2026 , defeating Pakistan by one wicket in a thrilling final at Al Amerat, Oman, on 14 November 2026. India secured its record-extending ninth title in the tournament.   
 Key Points:   
 Final Match: India defeated defending champions Pakistan by one wicket in the final of the Men's U-19 Asia Cup 2026.   
 Venue: Al Amerat Cricket Ground, Oman.   
 Pakistan's Score: 337/9 in 50 overs.   
 India's Score: 339/9 in 50 overs.   
 Target: 338 runs. India achieved the target on the final delivery of the match.   
 India's Record Ninth Title: India won its ninth Men's U-19 Asia Cup title , extending its record as the most successful team in the tournament.   
 The victory marked India's return to the title after its previous triumph in 2021 .   
 Key Performances by Indian Players:   
 Mohit Ulva: Scored an unbeaten 49 runs off 26 balls and hit the winning boundary on the final delivery.   
 Manal Chauhan: Scored 47 runs off 32 balls and shared a crucial 57-run partnership with Mohit Ulva for the ninth wicket.   
 Lakshya Raichandani: Contributed 80 runs.   
 Aaryavir Sehwag: Scored 58 runs and finished as the tournament's leading run-scorer.   
 Individual Awards:   
 Player of the Match: Mohit Ulva.   
 Player of the Tournament: Aaryavir Sehwag.   
 Leading Run-Scorer: Aaryavir Sehwag, with 361 runs in five innings.   
 Prime Minister's Congratulatory Message: Prime Minister Narendra Modi described the victory as an outstanding day for Indian cricket.   
 He expressed pride in the young cricketers for their impressive performance.   
 He highlighted that their achievement would inspire several youngsters to take up sports.   
 Significance: India's victory highlights the country's growing strength in age-group cricket and the importance of grassroots sports development.   
 The achievement is expected to inspire young sporting talent and encourage greater participation in cricket.
